import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
e=df['eps'].values; t=df['T'].values; s=df['sigma'].values
def run(name,f,n):
    best=(1e9,None)
    for trial in range(30):
        p0=np.random.RandomState(trial).uniform(-1.5,2,n)
        with np.errstate(all='ignore'):
            try:
                r=least_squares(lambda p: f(p)-s, p0, max_nfev=3000)
                v=np.mean(r.fun**2)/np.var(s)
                if np.isfinite(v) and v<best[0]: best=(v,r.x)
            except Exception: pass
    print(name, best[0], np.round(best[1],4))
run('ludwik_Tn', lambda p: p[0]*t**p[1] + p[2]*t**p[3]*e**(p[4]+p[5]*t), 6)
run('ludwik_Tn_log', lambda p: p[0]*t**p[1] + p[2]*t**p[3]*e**(p[4]+p[5]*t)*(1+p[6]*np.log(e)), 7)
run('ludwik_exp', lambda p: p[0]*t**p[1] + p[2]*t**p[3]*e**p[4]*np.exp(p[5]*e), 6)
run('two_power', lambda p: p[0]*t**p[1] + p[2]*t**p[3]*e**p[4] + p[5]*t**p[6]*e**p[7], 8)
